newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gibson says Q1 profit slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gibson says Q1 profit slightly lower.

text.p: SYDNEY, Nov 13 (Retuer) - Gibson Chemical Industries Ltd said on Wednesday its sales for the first quarter of the current financial year (July-June) have shown an increase over last year, but profits are maginally down.
Gibson reported a net profit of A$8.84 million in the year to June 30, 1996 from A$10.25 million.
Gibson managing director Robert Ooms told the company's annual general meeting that competition continues to be intense in all of the company's major markets.
But Ooms said Gibson's financial position continues to be sound.
"We believe we have everything in place to return to growth," he said.

"The restructuring that has been undertaken to date and which will continue to be fine-tuned, coupled with the enthusiasm and skills of our employees around the world, provide us with optimism for the future," Ooms said.
